arenas.name: The Glass Box
traits: Standard rectangle, clear walls, floodlights above.

arenas.name: The Echo Chamber
traits: Concrete walls: rebounds come back fast.

arenas.name: The Slope
traits: The floor tilts toward one goal. Ends swap at half-time.

arenas.name: The Narrows
traits: Long and thin: the centre lane is half-width.

arenas.name: The Octagon
traits: Angled corners send rebounds back toward goal.

arenas.name: The Cold Room
traits: Frosted glass, chilled air. Legs go early.

arenas.name: Mirror Hall
traits: Mirrored walls: keepers lose the ball in the reflections.

arenas.name: The Pit
traits: Sunken floor; the watchers look down through a glass ceiling. Silent.
